notes: 1.3.44: the setup window. INSTALL.bat now does a short bootstrap in its console and then opens Episode Factory's own window for the rest of the setup: your keys are asked there and shown masked once saved, the whole install shows a percentage and the step it is on, every download has its own bar, the log is a click away, and it ends with READY and a button to open the program. INSTALL.bat --check keeps the console. Also in this line: the app window (1.3.43), the picture judge (1.3.34), an update keeping your settings (1.3.35), the full Pixabay category table (1.3.41), space as a topic (1.3.42).
